concepts.title: Project-to-review human journey

concepts.rationale: Keep the concise comparison, not another diagram. Distinguish the code default in-api from deployed manifests selecting pod-per-run, and describe rollback as a configuration/deployment action rather than guaranteed instantaneous migration of active turns.

concepts.title: Proposal acceptance and rejection

concepts.title: Shared knowledge without peer messaging

concepts.title: Create, resume, idle, and delete personal conversations

findings.subject: USER VISUAL REJECTION: publication paused pending approved shared calibration
findings.detail: 2026-09-13: The user rejected the promoted experience sample as materially worse than the deleted React renderer: oversized title/type, excessive canvas prose, weak information density, flat oversized groups, inadequate hierarchy/whitespace discipline, generic draw.io appearance and loss of compact polished card rhythm. This rejection supersedes the historical completion/publication statements below. Preserve all research, audit and review evidence. Fourteen diagram identities were already promoted as 42 public PNG/drawio/hash files; exact absolute paths and snapshot hashes are recorded in the rejection report. No further authoring, mass production, public overwrites or automatic rollback is authorized before a revised shared visual calibration/template is approved. SQL revamp-diagrams-experience is blocked.

findings.subject: MCP OAuth visual and prose describe removed authentication paths
findings.detail: The onboarding OAuth figure still authenticates through GitHub and prose lists API keys/raw GitHub and org-only access. Current broker validation requires exact-resource RS256 broker credentials; real-process tests reject raw Entra, GitHub, and API keys. Redesign the experience OAuth figure and reconcile shared auth canonicals before publishing; no authentication code changes requested.

findings.subject: Screenshot coverage is largely placeholders, not captured evidence
findings.detail: Audited 44 unique screenshot paths: 35 share the exact first 350,000 decompressed PNG bytes (including the placeholder title/header) of the visually inspected placeholder family, three are identical 1x1/70-byte images, and six are real product captures that were visually inspected. app-shell, overview-fleet, and cluster-page were also visually inspected; cluster-page displays the heartbeat placeholder. Eight files including app-shell.png are byte-identical. Most captions read as completed capture descriptions. These assets block visual publication claims, not completion of this research report.

findings.subject: Current board layout and launch modes contradict repeated journey claims
findings.detail: Logical buckets remain six, but the UI renders Backlog/Ready/Active/Done plus separate Human Review/Problems attention panels. Direct bypasses outcome confirmation; unattended pickup also confirms without a manual gate. Reconcile shared board/coordinator canonicals and all affected captions without changing product graphs.

findings.subject: A2A recovery is visible and policy-driven, not guaranteed transparent replay
findings.detail: The operator diagram promises direct replay after any mid-turn drop. RemoteAgentProxy instead emits structured retryable incomplete-turn/transport failures, allowing conscious redispatch. Keep leaf-turn/gate separation but remove no-gap/no-duplicate/no-manual-recovery absolutes. Pod indicators are also visible, contradicting no transport distinction at all.

findings.subject: Preview paths and defaults conflict within the experience set
findings.detail: Sandbox-pod page still describes kubectl loopback/no URL/no TTL; current implementation provisions Gateway HTTPRoute/Service. Browser-preview and live-preview pages conflict on approval/lifetime defaults. Current project defaults are 1440 minutes and initial expiry/hard cap use the same lifetime. PreviewStep runs after approved OR request-changes and remains non-blocking; preserve retained preview resources as an exception to unconditional pod release.

findings.subject: Retry and human-review budgets need qualified state transitions
findings.detail: Runs/MCP tables say retry always creates a fresh run, but tests cover same-run coordinator resume. Unified steering says budget exhaustion becomes blocked/terminal, whereas reviewable assembly escalates to human review and new human requests reset autonomy counters. Generic review caps must not be applied to collective human round trips.

findings.subject: Operator scaling guidance presents proposed autoscaling as deployed
findings.detail: Worker HPA currently scales on CPU 70% and memory 80%, min 2/max 3. KEDA backlog and web HPA are commented examples. Distinguish current deployment from historical phase planning; provider flips and scaling workers to zero alone are not verified rollback recipes.

findings.subject: Memory context requires explicit trust; exports are not the runtime authority
findings.detail: Communication prose implies cross-team tag alone propagates memory, and the team diagram loops exported files directly into sessions. Compiler requires approved cross-agent memory, excludes legacy records, selects active approved boundary decisions, and serializes untrusted data. Coordinate shared canonical-memory-context updates with its owner.

findings.subject: Navigation and static surface descriptions have drifted
findings.detail: Global Settings is now Account settings, project root is Dashboard, and standalone Workflow/Execution pages are gone. Overview captions describe old tables; Cluster appendix describes removed CPU quota bars; Memories now has Session history. Keep concise navigation tables and refresh capture briefs against actual components.

findings.subject: Agent access and generation descriptions must follow current contracts
findings.detail: Assistant uses renewable five-minute MCP broker credentials, not raw Entra for MCP. GitHub project creation needs Repo App-authorized selection codes, not arbitrary pasted repositories without access. Driver-file materialization is best-effort, not an unconditional guarantee. Complete MCP catalog claims are stale: source currently declares 107 tools across 14 tool classes.

findings.subject: Trace identity documentation lags typed recorded session attributes
findings.detail: Transaction-traces says no session identifier is returned, but current RunTraceSpanAttributes has optional sessionId and the panel reads it when recorded. Retain truthful missing-data fallback; do not invent IDs, but do not prohibit an existing recorded field.

findings.subject: Consolidation preserves useful user journeys rather than all implementation detail
findings.detail: Recommend three owned merges and two owned reuses; retain seven distinct high-level concepts and redesign seven in place. Keep small inline decision-state Mermaid, but merge duplicate run-state Mermaid into canonical-board-lifecycle. No genuinely missing standalone graphic was necessary: uncovered features are adequately served by prose/tables, actual product captures, or existing cross-owner canonicals.
